experiments.name: Original real-data experiment
experiments.cohort: Earlier 74-participant TOLIFE release; eligible test rows from 10 participants. Separate from the newer 86-participant monitoring archive.
experiments.interpretation: Missed every positive test window at the frozen selected threshold. Not used as a clinical risk service.

experiments.name: Synthetic v2 primary confirmation
experiments.cohort: Conditional fictional simulation, same source profiles; not an independent clinical cohort. Scores cover eligible runtime prediction days.
experiments.interpretation: Low positive-window recall and sparse calendar coverage. Simulation performance does not validate clinical prediction.

interpretation: Frozen aggregate project audit. Overall accuracy is not evidence of useful clinical forecasting. No clinical validation or seven-day probability is established. Public distribution excludes real-person records. Historical research metrics are retained as aggregates only.
